# `gcp.httpshealthcheck`

An HttpsHealthCheck resource. This resource defines a template for how individual VMs should be checked for health, via HTTPS. ~> **Note:** google_compute_https_health_check is a legacy health check. The newer \[google_compute_health_check\](/docs/providers/google/r/compute_health_check.html) should be preferred for all uses except \[Network Load Balancers\](https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/load-balancing/network/) which still require the legacy version.
